_comment: Declared parameters of the measure and of the two reference campaigns, exactly as run (paper Sec. 3.4 and Sec. 4.2).

latency.distribution: Gaussian, zero mean, rectified at zero and bounded (dlat = clip(N(0, sigma), -bound, bound); negative draws act as zero delay in both adapters)

friction.distribution: uniform multiplicative scale on achievable deceleration (brake-command gain in both adapters)

actor_noise.distribution: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck acceleration noise on the threat actor

kernel.rescaling: Kernel.scaled(alpha) multiplies every spread by alpha with nominal centres fixed; RQ3 uses alpha in {0.5, 2}

severity_curve.form: logit iota = a + b * s, s = relative speed at contact in km/h; iota(0) = 0 for non-contact replays
severity_curve.source: Kusano and Gabler MAIS2+ occupant injury-risk logistic (NASS/CDS rear-end), belt covariate dropped

branch.t_crit: time of first contact, else of minimum TTC among active closing steps, else of minimum gap (proxima/trace.py)
branch.latency_rule: latency jitter applies only if the evasive reaction has not begun at t*

campaign.replay_draws: numpy default_rng([execution_seed, 999]) -> Kernel.sample(M); replay m runs with seed execution_seed * 100 + m

rq3_kernel_rescaling.note: same underlying draws as the reference campaign (common random numbers)

openpilot.simulator: MetaDrive via openpilot's official simulation bridge (tools/sim)

transfuser.simulator: CARLA 0.9.10.1, synchronous, Town01, leaderboard agent interface
